environment.description: Production Kubernetes deployment. LaunchDarkly project 'notification-svc-prod' has flag 'enable-dynamic-template-rendering' configured with targeting rules: the flag's default variation is FALSE, with a prerequisite flag 'template-rendering-killswitch' that must evaluate to 'active' (currently evaluates to 'inactive' for all contexts). The flag has a scheduled rollout set to 0% with no future ramp date configured. Additionally, the flag's 'Off' variation is served when the SDK cannot reach LaunchDarkly (offline mode fallback). The SDK is initialized with Config.Offline = false but the default value parameter in BoolVariation is false. Note: the template funcMap still includes os.Getenv but the code path calling renderDynamicTemplate is unreachable due to the flag evaluation always returning false.

config.flag_targeting_status: targeting ON, but all rules evaluate to false variation
config.kafka_topic_acl: any authenticated producer can write to notifications topic
